newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest stocks up in extended strong rally.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest stocks up in extended strong rally.

text.p: Most Bucharest stocks climbed to new average price and closing highs on Friday in a bullish phase that has been a market feature throughout the week.
Higher average price gains were on the second tier, showing a reorientation of investors to cheaper stocks, traders said.

"The first tier had stellar performance, taking the bulk of volume and turnover mostly on the back of foreign buying, but pressure was real high in the lower section, with gains of up to 49 percent," said a trader.

Twenty-eight stocks saw higher average prices, seven drifted lower and three marked time. Six companies had no trade and two were suspended. Operators said they expected the market to keep on growing next week.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, hit all-time highs, jumping by 13.54, 13.43 and 13.62 percent respectively from Thursday.
Volume thickened to 4.2 million shares from 3.9 million previously, with turnover adding 4.7 billion lei to rise to 22.2 billion.
There were three special trades in Antibiotice pharmaceuticals and chemical plants Oltchim and Sinteza, involving a total 1.09 million shares worth an overall 5.98 billion lei.

The first tier took 85 percent of total volume and 90 percent of turnover. The leading gainer in this section was Oltchim, with a 21 percent rise in its average price and a close 850 lei stronger at 5,950.

On the bottom tier, Sidertrans transport company and Mobila Alfa furniture maker had average price gains of 49 and 46 percent respectively. But the section's star was Armatura fittings maker, with 760 million lei in turnover. It firmed 600 lei to a 6,450 lei close.
